commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Search Packagist packages by keyword, optionally filtered by package type and tags. Uses the official search.json API.

commands.name: search-packages-faceted
commands.summary: Search packages through the site's Algolia index. Returns hits plus facet counts per tag and type. Supports Algolia filter expressions; page is 0-based.

commands.name: search-facet-values
commands.summary: Search the values of a search facet (tags or type) by prefix, with counts within a keyword query. Useful for finding valid tag names to filter on.

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get full package metadata as JSON: description, maintainers, repository, download totals, favers, and all versions with their requirements.

commands.name: get-package-install-stats
commands.summary: Get a time series of daily installs for a package, averaged daily, weekly or monthly, starting from a date.

commands.name: get-package-major-version-stats
commands.summary: Get a time series of daily installs for a package, split by major version (1, 2, 3, ...).

commands.name: get-package-php-stats
commands.summary: Get a time series of installs for a package, split by the PHP version (and HHVM) used by installers.

commands.name: get-version-details
commands.summary: Get the rendered detail block for one package version by its numeric version id: version number, release date, and requires/suggests/provides/conflicts. Returned as an HTML fragment inside JSON.

commands.name: list-dependents
commands.summary: List packages that depend on a given package. Can sort by downloads and filter by require or require-dev.

commands.name: list-suggesters
commands.summary: List packages that suggest a given package in their composer.json 'suggest' section.

commands.name: list-security-advisories
commands.summary: List known security advisories (PKSA id, CVE, affected versions, severity) for a package via the official API.

commands.name: get-security-advisory
commands.summary: Get one security advisory by its PKSA id: severity, title, CVE/GHSA ids, affected package and versions, and reporting sources.

commands.name: list-vendor-packages
commands.summary: List all package names published under a vendor, optionally filtered by package type.

commands.name: list-popular-packages
commands.summary: List the most popular packages on Packagist, paginated.

commands.name: browse-explore
commands.summary: Get the Browse page lists, in this order: New Releases (with version), New Packages, Popular Packages and Random Packages.

commands.name: list-php-extensions
commands.summary: List PHP extension packages that can be installed with PIE, paginated.

commands.name: get-global-statistics
commands.summary: Get Packagist-wide totals: packages registered, versions available, and total package installs since 2012.
